content.comment_body: Hello everyone, is it possible to use [product_name] AI module from [version_no] with a [version_no] unit? Kind regards, [user_name]
Hi, that isn't possible. Please check the following for details: [document] (review compatibility section). Best regards, [user_name]

[version_no] does not officially support expansions from [version_no]. Unofficially, there's some discussion in German forums about using [version_no] hardware with the newer CPU, but it's not recommended.
Do you have a link? It's quite frustrating to buy hardware and then find out you have to replace it because old expansion modules aren't supported.

No, hardware produced before [version_no] isn't compatible with the [version_no]. 1) The connectors have different mechanical coding. 2) The bus communication protocol in the [version_no] differs from previous versions.
Check the attached PDF on page 2 and read the highlighted yellow text.

All expansion units for the [product_name] [version_no] have article numbers ending with [article_no]. Older modules such as those with [article_no] are for earlier versions ([version_no] and previous). This naming is consistent except for the operator panels.

I didn't save the link, but it's posted somewhere at [url]. It's safe to say that the experiment I mentioned isn't practical—this has been confirmed by German-speaking users. You should contact your supplier for help finding the correct hardware. You might still be able to get CPUs from previous versions without additional cost. For example, a recent purchase included a CPU from a previous version, which worked with expansions designed for earlier models. Good luck.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are frustrated due to incompatibility between new base modules and older expansion hardware. Mechanical and protocol changes prevent using previous expansion modules with newer units, leading to wasted inventory and upgrade difficulties. Official sources confirm this incompatibility, and workarounds are unreliable, creating user dissatisfaction during system upgrades.
analysis.user_expectations: Users hoped for backward compatibility so expansion modules from previous versions could be used with newer units, limiting waste and easing transitions during upgrades.
